rules: Replaces its ancestry trait with halfling (or adds it); adds Halfling, size Small, Keen Eyes.

abilities.name: Keen Eyes
abilities.description: {Name} gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find hidden or undetected creatures within 30 feet of them. Whenever {name} targets a creature that is concealed or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.
